topic: The "interview me first" prompt: let Claude ask you questions before it starts
post:
Not sure how to write the "perfect prompt"? 🤔
Don't. Let Claude interview you instead.

Anthropic's own prompting guide says that giving Claude context, like why you need something, helps it give more targeted answers.

But most of us forget half the context. So flip it around: ask Claude to ask YOU the questions first.

Copy-paste prompt 👇

"I need help with [your task]. Before you start, ask me up to 5 questions you need answered to do this really well. Ask them one at a time. When you have enough, tell me your plan, then do it."

Try it on:
📧 A tricky email to a client
📊 A project update for your boss
🎤 A short speech or toast
🗓️ Planning a team offsite

Why one question at a time? ✅
It feels like a real conversation, and your answers stay short and easy.

Why it matters:
The hardest part of using AI isn't the tool. It's knowing what to say. This prompt turns a blank box into a friendly interview, and the answer gets better because Claude finally has your context. 💡

What task would you let Claude interview you about? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #Productivity
